text:
rachael: Heads-up: after the v1->v2 soft-roll last night we got two noise reports: unexpected quota hits and confusing console state. Need quick sync on visibility + a short circuit-breaker in console for auto-flips.

mike: Can you summarise what tenants saw? Was it billing, throttles, or both?

rachael: Mix. Mostly bursty quota errors for tenants with heavy short requests, plus a few support tickets where console still showed "v1" even though routing flipped.

zubin: That sounds like a race between route table update and console cache invalidation. We currently invalidate console cache on route-change event but the event is async and can lag ~10-30s.

infra-bot: deploy: rollout v2-auto-flip to 20% completed at 2025-12-05T02:10:12Z.

mike: Two proposals: 1) show "migration pending" state in console immediately when we schedule a flip, and 2) add an emergency circuit-breaker toggle that pauses auto-flips per-tenant.

harry: For telemetry we should emit `migration_state` (scheduled/pending/active/complete) and `migration_reason` (console/manual/autoswitch). That lets ops filter any anomalies tied to how the flip was initiated.

mica: UX: add an inline banner on tenant page: "Migration scheduled (click to pause). Estimated warmup: 3m. View details -> ". Keep CTA small.

rachael: Ops asked for a per-tenant quick revert button in the console that only flips routing back and sets a tagging flag so we can audit. Not full rollback, just quick revert.

zubin: Backend: revert button -> create route change event with origin=console_revert and `revert_marker=true`. Telemetry will capture it. Need to ensure we don't create oscillations. Add a cooldown flag for 10m per tenant.

mike: Quota issue: tenants triggered rate-limit because many clients retried after transient 429s during warmup. Two mitigations: token-saver mode (cap max seq-len) and client-facing header `X-Migration-Suggested-Backoff`. We can also add a short TTL on throttle counters during migration to avoid double-counting retries.

harry: I'd rather avoid changing throttle semantics broadly. Suggest adding a migration-aware throttle window: maintain a separate `migration_retry_bucket` that decays faster. That prevents retry storms from inflating normal quota metrics.

mica: Console copy for circuit-breaker: "Pause automatic migrations for this tenant. Use when you see unexpected cost or throttles. Pausing will keep current model routing until you resume." Include a secondary action "Safe-canary 5%" so users can opt to only migrate a slice.

zubin: Telemetry specifics: emit counters every 30s: `tenant.migration.tokens.30s`, `tenant.migration.fallback_tokens.30s`, `tenant.migration.kv_miss_rate.30s`, and a boolean `tenant.migration.paused`. Keep labels low-cardinality: tenant_id, migration_state, route_origin. Sample raw traces at 1% by default, 10% during the first 5 minutes after schedule.

rachael: Good. Also please add a console endpoint `GET /tenants/{id}/migration/preview` that returns estimated $ impact and suggested mitigation (cap seq-len, safe-canary) before we flip. Help CS answer questions.

mike: We should also add an internal alert: if `migration.fallback_tokens.1m` > 40% and `migration.kv_miss_rate.1m` > 0.2 concurrently, page oncall and create an incident note prefilled with affected tenant and last 15 min graph links.

billing-bot: billing-note: default billing policy remains "bill for model served". Any temporary grace/refund policy requires Legal sign-off; you can add a "simulate_billing=true" mode for canaries so we record but don't charge.

harry: For console state lag we can also add optimistic UI update: set UI to pending state as soon as the flip is scheduled and update to final when event confirmed. That reduces confusion.

mica: Agree. UX must show an explicit timestamp and "last updated by" so customers see who triggered the flip.

rachael: Action list: zubin -> route_event + revert/cooldown + migration telemetry; harry -> alert rules; mica -> console pill + revert + safe-canary action + optimistic UI; mike -> throttle migration bucket + token-saver feature; billing-bot/legal -> simulate_billing mode guidance.

zubin: I'll PR the route event changes and add the 30s aggregated counters. Can someone own the endpoint for migration/preview?

mike: I'll take migration/preview API and the token-saver enforcement.

mike: Quickie: sample SQL for the preview aggregator (will run in metrics infra):

```
SELECT
  tenant_id,
  sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE migration_state='active') AS migration_tokens,
  sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE migration_state='steady') AS baseline_tokens,
  (sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE migration_state='active') - sum(tokens) FILTER (WHERE migration_state='steady')) AS token_delta
FROM request_metrics
WHERE ts >= now() - interval '10 minutes'
GROUP BY tenant_id
LIMIT 100;
```

harry: I'll draft alert runbook and page template. We'll include recommended mitigations and a link to quick revert in console.

mica: I'll post mocks in #design later today. Keep language low-friction.

rachael: Thanks everyone. If no objections, let's aim to ship the telemetry + optimistic UI + circuit-breaker to canary tenants by next Wednesday. Add blockers as replies. :thumbsup:
